description: Legacy-compatible 26-expression visual-novel set with character-agnostic acting directions.

expressions.label: Amused
expressions.instruction: Show quiet amusement: a slight smirk at one corner of the mouth and eyes narrowed with a knowing glint. Keep the body relaxed and unhurried, weight settled back and shoulders easy.

expressions.label: Angry
expressions.instruction: Show restrained anger: brows sharply pulled together, jaw set, and eyes cold and hard. Make the body rigid and confrontational, shoulders squared and posture braced.

expressions.label: Annoyed
expressions.instruction: Show plain annoyance: eyes rolled upward, brows raised, and lips pressed flat. Use exasperated body language with a stiff posture and barely restrained huff.

expressions.label: Beaming
expressions.instruction: Show a genuine wide smile with teeth slightly visible and eyes crinkled at the corners. Keep the body warm and open, shoulders light and posture relaxed and unguarded.

expressions.label: Blushing
expressions.instruction: Show flustered self-consciousness: a visible blush, eyes averted downward, brows slightly raised, and lips pressed softly together. Draw the shoulders inward and make the posture tight with embarrassment.

expressions.label: Comedic Shock
expressions.instruction: Show exaggerated comic shock: eyes wide and round, brows shot upward, and mouth dropped open. Freeze the body mid-motion in a split second of total surprise.

expressions.label: Confident
expressions.instruction: Show calm self-assurance: chin slightly raised, lips in a quiet knowing smile, and eyes direct and unhurried. Keep the shoulders back and the posture grounded, open, and authoritative.

expressions.label: Crying
expressions.instruction: Show active grief: tears visible, eyes glassy and red-rimmed, brows drawn together with pain, and lower lip trembling. Collapse the posture inward with a lowered head and hunched shoulders.

expressions.label: Embarrassed
expressions.instruction: Show acute embarrassment: eyes averted hard to one side, brows furrowed, and mouth in a tight grimace. Make the body stiff and mortified, shoulders sharply drawn inward as if trying to disappear.

expressions.label: Emotional
expressions.instruction: Show open vulnerability: eyes wide and slightly shining, brows softly raised, and lips barely parted. Keep the posture quiet, still, exposed, and genuinely moved.

expressions.label: Emotional Shock
expressions.instruction: Show stunned disbelief: eyes wide and unblinking, mouth barely parted, and expression frozen. Lock the shoulders and hold the body completely still as if the world has stopped.

expressions.label: Flirty
expressions.instruction: Show understated flirtation: lips curved in a slow knowing smile, eyes half-lidded, and one brow slightly raised. Keep the posture loose, inviting, and quietly confident with a slight head tilt.

expressions.label: Happy
expressions.instruction: Show warm contentment: a small genuine smile, soft slightly crinkled eyes, and relaxed brows. Keep the shoulders loose and the posture open, comfortable, and at ease.

expressions.label: Intimate
expressions.instruction: Show a tender intimate look: eyes half-lidded and steady, lips slightly parted, and brows soft. Lean slightly inward with calm, deliberate, focused warmth.

expressions.label: Laughing
expressions.instruction: Show genuine laughter: mouth open in a real laugh, eyes nearly closed with amusement, and brows raised. Tilt the head back and keep the shoulders loose and animated.

expressions.label: Nervous
expressions.instruction: Show anxious unease: eyes darting aside, brows raised and worried, mouth in a tense line, and jaw tight. Hunch the shoulders and make the posture restless and coiled with nervous energy.

expressions.label: Neutral
expressions.instruction: Show composed neutrality: brows level, mouth closed, eyes forward, and jaw relaxed. Keep the body still and controlled with a straight, natural posture.

expressions.label: Sad
expressions.instruction: Show quiet sadness: eyes downcast, brows drawn with inner corners raised, and mouth in a thin unhappy line. Make the posture heavy and withdrawn with slightly slumped shoulders.

expressions.label: Shy
expressions.instruction: Show self-conscious shyness: eyes lowered and averted, brows gently raised, and mouth softly closed. Draw the shoulders inward and look up hesitantly from under the brow.

expressions.label: Sleepy or Tired
expressions.instruction: Show heavy tiredness: eyelids drooping, brows low and relaxed, and mouth soft and slightly open. Let the head rest to one side and the posture sag with fatigue.

expressions.label: Smiling
expressions.instruction: Show a gentle closed-mouth smile with warm slightly crinkled eyes and relaxed brows. Keep the posture calm, easy, open, and approachable.

expressions.label: Stoic
expressions.instruction: Show cold stoicism: expression hardened and unreadable, jaw set, eyes focused and distant, and brows level. Square the shoulders and keep the body rigid and closed like a wall.

expressions.label: Surprised
expressions.instruction: Show genuine surprise: brows raised, eyes widened, and mouth slightly open. Lean back slightly as an instinctive response to being caught off guard.

expressions.label: Upset
expressions.instruction: Show quiet hurt: brows furrowed, lips pressed thin, and eyes averted sharply to one side. Pull the shoulders tight and close the posture with restrained emotion.

expressions.label: Wary
expressions.instruction: Show guarded suspicion: eyes narrowed, brows slightly furrowed, and mouth tight and closed. Angle the body away, shift the weight back, and keep the posture watchful and ready.

expressions.label: Worried or Concerned
expressions.instruction: Show deep concern: brow furrowed, eyes focused with worried intensity, and mouth tightened. Lean slightly forward with taut posture, weight, focus, and urgency.
